FAQ

Questions? Answers.

How does Free Preview work?+
Free Preview gives you six lifetime monitoring runs across up to 3 topics, with Daily or slower Custom intervals. No credit card is required. The runs do not renew.
What are monitoring templates?+
Templates are monitors that are already built for a common job: a price drop, a job opening, an AI model release, an IPO filing, a DeFi exploit, and more. You pick one, fill in a blank or two such as a link or a company name, and it starts running. There are 19 in the gallery and they are included with every paid plan.
What is Auto monitoring?+
Auto sets each topic's check frequency for you. It speeds up while a topic is busy and slows down when it goes quiet, so you do not have to manage a schedule. Prefer to decide yourself? Custom lets you pick any interval your plan unlocks, from ASAP mode all the way down to once a year.
Where do my alerts show up?+
In your feed and as a push notification on every plan. Paid plans add email alerts, the daily digest email, Slack, Discord, webhooks, and the REST API. You choose the channels per topic.
Is there an API?+
Yes. Every paid plan includes the AyeWatch REST API: create, list, update, and delete topics programmatically, and receive signed topic.update webhook events with AI-generated summaries.
Can I cancel anytime?+
Yes. No contracts or cancellation fees. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel any time. You keep access until the end of your billing period.
Will my inbox get flooded with alerts?+
No. Auto monitoring tunes each topic's check frequency for you, and Custom lets you pick any interval from a few-times-a-day to weekly. Reserve real-time for the handful of topics that actually matter. You can mute, pause, or change a topic anytime.
Do you train AI on my topics or alerts?+
No. Your monitors, topics, and alert history are private to your account. We do not sell your data, share what you monitor, or train models on your private monitoring activity.
How accurate are alerts? Will I get false positives?+
AyeWatch uses AI that understands meaning, not just keywords, to reduce noisy matches. You can mute, pause, or tighten any topic anytime, and corrections stay visible in your feed when a story changes.
What if I don't know what to monitor yet?+
Start with one topic that's been on your mind: a competitor, market, person, product, URL, or question you keep Googling. You can change or delete monitors anytime.
How is AyeWatch different from Google Alerts?+
Google Alerts mainly searches Google's web index using basic keyword matching and delayed delivery. AyeWatch monitors news, social media, blogs, forums, and specific webpages using AI that understands meaning and alerts you when something actually changes.
What sources does AyeWatch monitor?+
AyeWatch monitors over 1 billion sources across the internet: news sites, social platforms, forums, blogs, government pages, academic publications, and specific webpages you add yourself.
What is ASAP mode?+
ASAP is the fastest monitoring mode, designed for urgent topics such as market movements, breaking news, competitive intelligence, and other time-sensitive updates. It is available on higher plans.
Can I monitor specific web pages for changes?+
Yes. In addition to topic monitoring, you can track specific URLs and get alerted when meaningful content changes on competitor websites, job boards, regulatory pages, product pages, and more.
What is monitoring capacity?+
Monitoring capacity is how much checking your plan does each period. Slow checks use very little; hourly and real-time checks use more. If a new or faster topic will not fit, AyeWatch tells you before you commit.
What platforms is AyeWatch available on?+
AyeWatch works on web, iOS, and Android. Your topics, feed, alerts, and digest sync across platforms, so you can create monitors on the web and get alerts on your phone.
